messages:
Anya M.: Quick follow-up to the v6 migration RFC — we still have a class of clients that strip/normalize headers (notably X-Client-Version). Need a concrete graceful-degrade strategy for those clients so we don't break traffic.
Ryan C.: Agree. Two quick options: 1) edge shim that infers version from payload shape, 2) default to a compatibility model variant for unknown clients. Both have tradeoffs.
Maria S.: For option 1 we need a very small inference surface to avoid false-positive routing. Payload heuristics + UA parsing might be enough for 80%.
Sam B.: Option 2 is operationally simpler but increases cost. Defaulting to compat model bumps tokens and latencies for unknowns.
Kevin L.: Could we combine: try fast header-based routing, fall back to payload-shape probe for a short window, then mark tenant as "unknown" and route to compat until tenant opts in? Put a TTL so we re-probe.
Anya M.: That hybrid sounds reasonable. We also need telemetry events and a kill-switch. We must be able to flip everyone to compat quickly if we see regressions.
Ryan C.: Telemetry: emit compat_probe.{success|fail}, compat_route.count, compat_route.latency_p90, compat_quality.regression.{metric}.
Maria S.: Also log sample payloads for failed probes (scrubbed) so ML can tune heuristics. Keep sampling low (0.1%) to avoid PII issues.
Sam B.: Implementation plan suggestion:
- edge-proxy: small probe module (0.5ms) that checks body shape + UA
- control-plane: tenant opt_state (known/unknown/probing)
- runtime: compat model variant tag
- console: per-tenant view + ability to force opt_state
Kevin L.: Add a canary rollout: start with internal tenants -> beta customers -> broader traffic. We'll need a migration flag in tenant config and an admin API to flip.
Anya M.: Ops checklist:
- rollout playbook with thresholds (error-rate increase > 1%, latency increase > 20ms)
- automatic rollback on threshold breach
- feature flag for immediate global fallback
Ryan C.: Question: how long do we keep "compat" for a tenant before re-probing? 24h? 7d?
Maria S.: 24h with exponential backoff for re-probes. If tenant explicitly upgrades/makes compatible handshake, clear state.
Sam B.: Cost guardrails: if compat traffic > 5% of a shard, trigger autoscale/alert and consider rate-limiting degrade.
Kevin L.: Small code snippet for tenant config we talked about:

```
"tenant_opt_state": {
  "state": "probing", // known|probing|compat
  "last_probe": "2024-10-03T12:34:00Z",
  "probe_rate": 0.01
}
```

Anya M.: Nice. Who wants to pick up the RFC follow-up PR? We should capture the heuristics and the observability contract.
Ryan C.: I'll draft the PR for edge-proxy probe + telemetry schema.
Maria S.: I'll handle the ML heuristics doc and sample scrubber.
Sam B.: I'll add runtime compat-variant plumbing and feature flags.
Kevin L.: I'll own the rollout playbook and admin API endpoints.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Scheduled deployment window: edge-proxy probe (canary) -> 2024-10-10 01:00 UTC
Anya M.: Thanks all. Let's sync tomorrow 10am to review PRs. :thumbsup:
Ryan C.: ack
Maria S.: ack
Sam B.: ack
Kevin L.: ack
